description: Single precision op-amp with 3 fA typical input bias current (±20 fA max at 25°C), ±26 µV offset voltage, 17 MHz GBW and 1.3 mA supply current, running from 1.8 V to 5.5 V. Its non-standard SOIC-8 pinout keeps the inputs away from the supply and output pins. Uses include electrometers, photodiode amplifiers and transimpedance amplifiers.
